components_structure.Header: App top bar with Large High-Contrast Toggle, Text Resizer (A- / A+), Help button, and Back/Home Navigation.
components_structure.ModeSelector: Three distinct large cards with large icons and descriptions for Voice Only, Text Only, and Voice+Text.
components_structure.VoiceBar: Prominent sticky or centered Voice Assistant box featuring 'Tap to Speak' mic button, pulsating wave indicator, live transcript, and voice feedback playback.
components_structure.DashboardGrid: 3x3 responsive grid (or 1-col on mobile) of prominent action cards with high contrast blue borders, bold 32px+ icons, and clear text labels.
components_structure.TransactionFlowModal: Multi-step modal/page with step progress bar (Review -> PIN -> Result), extra large PIN input, and distinct green ✓ success or red ✕ failure state screens.

instructions_to_main_agent: Build a complete, accessible, mobile-first web app prototype in React for VoiceBank.
Maintain a crisp light blue and white theme (#FFFFFF background, #0256B3 primary blue, #F0F7FF card background).
Do NOT use complex dark fintech dashboards or heavy gradients. Everything must be high-contrast, clean, and ultra-legible.

Implement simulated Speech-to-Text and Text-to-Speech using Web Speech API (or simulated fallback) so users can tap 'Speak' or type natural commands like 'Check balance', 'Send 500 to Rahul', 'Pay electricity bill'.
Provide a global Font Scale controller (Normal, Large, Extra Large) and High Contrast mode toggle in the header.
Ensure ALL interactive elements (buttons, inputs, cards, tabs, options) have unique, kebab-case data-testid attributes.
Include full end-to-end flows for Send Money (with PIN verification & Success/Failure simulation), Bill Pay, Recharge, Beneficiaries, Notifications, and Help Guide.
Keep language simple, reassuring, and direct. Pair every icon with bold text.

UNIVERSAL GUIDELINES FOR MAIN AGENT.Avoid Slop: Do not create cramped, tiny-font or generic centered templates. Use generous spacing, explicit touch targets, and crisp blue borders.
UNIVERSAL GUIDELINES FOR MAIN AGENT.Color Usage: Light blue (#F0F7FF) background tint for cards, solid navy (#0256B3) for primary action buttons, dark charcoal (#0B192C) for text.
UNIVERSAL GUIDELINES FOR MAIN AGENT.Iconography: Use Lucide-react icons with strokeWidth={2.5} or 3, size 28-36px minimum. Always pair with text labels.
UNIVERSAL GUIDELINES FOR MAIN AGENT.Testing: Add data-testid to every button, input, balance card, modal, PIN key, and navigation item.
